gloss_en: The Zoharic Aramaic phrase 'trein re'in d'la mitparshin' — 'the two companions who are never separated' — designating the inseparable pair Chokhmah and Binah (the divine letters yud-heh, the two aspects of the divine mind); here embedded in the clause 'that the two never-separating companions should draw near (to each other)'
